name: JET Optoelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: JET Optoelectronics Co., Ltd., headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, is an enterprise specializing in the development and production of automotive electronic systems. The company's innovative portfolio, catering to both Taiwanese and global markets, includes sophisticated rear-seat entertainment units, advanced vehicle telematics, and a variety of accessories, such as in-car cameras. The firm commenced operations in 2010.
